children: Prices of silver were quite unchanged on Monday, September 7, according to Dahab Masr’s data at 3:54 PM.
The local price registered EGP 106.7 for purchase and EGP 101.15 for sale.
Globally, the international ounce reached $65.72 for buying and $65.46 for selling.
